# cato_rbac_assignment (Resource)

Manages one RBAC assignment for a user or users group through the beta RBAC APIs. Updates replace all roles and scope. Legacy ADMIN assignments cannot be managed. Import with ACCOUNT_ID:ASSIGNMENT_ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use a role with only the permissions required by this assignment.
resource "cato_role" "site_viewer" {
  name = "Terraform site viewer"
  permissions = [{ resource = "Sites", action = "VIEW" }]
}

resource "cato_rbac_assignment" "example" {
  user_id = "12345" # Existing user ID. Replace with your account's user ID.
  # group_id = "67890" # Use an existing users group instead of user_id.
  # account_id = "123456" # Defaults to the provider account_id.

  role_ids = [cato_role.site_viewer.role_id]
  allowed_entities = [
    { id = "54321", type = "SITE", action = "VIEW" }
    # Use SYSTEMGROUP entity IDs for account-wide scope.
    # Other supported types: USERSGROUP, GROUP, SYSTEMGROUP,
    # WAN_FIREWALL_POLICY, INTERNET_FIREWALL_POLICY.
  ]
  # Use allowed_entities = [] for no individual entities.
  # allow_viewing_unobfuscated_data = false
  # description = "View the selected site"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_entities` (Attributes Set) Complete individual entity scope. Use [] for no individual entities; use SYSTEMGROUP entries for account-wide access. Each type/ID pair may appear once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed_entities))
- `role_ids` (Set of String) Complete nonempty set of role IDs to assign, including custom or predefined roles.

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Owning account. Defaults to the provider account_id. Changing it replaces the assignment.
- `allow_viewing_unobfuscated_data` (Boolean) Whether this assignment may view unobfuscated data. Omit to leave the API preference unchanged on update. When account obfuscation is DISABLED, the API hides the stored preference and refresh preserves the configured value. Import cannot recover that hidden preference.
- `description` (String) Assignment description. Omit or set an empty string to clear it.
- `group_id` (String) Users group ID to assign. Changing the principal replaces the assignment.
- `user_id` (String) User ID to assign. Specify exactly one of user_id or group_id. Changing the principal replaces the assignment.

### Read-Only

- `allow_all_sites` (String) Effective access to all sites, derived from SYSTEMGROUP scope: NONE, VIEW or EDIT.
- `allow_all_users` (String) Effective access to all users, derived from SYSTEMGROUP scope: NONE, VIEW or EDIT.
- `assignment_id` (String) Stable API assignment identifier.
- `assignment_type` (String) API assignment type: ADMIN_USER or GROUP.
- `data_obfuscation_status` (String) Effective API status: OBFUSCATED, UNOBFUSCATED or DISABLED.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in ACCOUNT_ID:ASSIGNMENT_ID format.

<a id="nestedatt--allowed_entities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowed_entities`

Required:

- `action` (String) Access to the entity: VIEW or EDIT.
- `id` (String) Stable entity ID.
- `type` (String) Entity type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cato_rbac_assignment.example ACCOUNT_ID:ASSIGNMENT_ID
```
